name: frozen_watermark_on_upsert
title: Keep each customer's first-seen time on re-sync
body: The audit view should show when we first saw a customer. Re-syncing a customer overwrote updated_at, so this keeps the existing value on conflict.

import datetime

from .db import connect


def upsert_customer(conn, row):
    """Insert or update one customer from the CRM feed."""
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    conn.execute(
        """
        INSERT INTO customers (id, name, email, tier, updated_at)
        VALUES (%(id)s, %(name)s, %(email)s, %(tier)s, %(now)s)
        ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
           SET name = EXCLUDED.name,
               email = EXCLUDED.email,
               tier = EXCLUDED.tier,
               -- keep the original timestamp so the audit view shows when the
               -- customer was first seen
               updated_at = customers.updated_at
        """,
        {**row, "now": now},
    )


def sync(feed):
    with connect() as conn:
        for row in feed:
            upsert_customer(conn, row)

defects.what: updated_at no longer moves on update, so the incremental export (WHERE updated_at > watermark) never sees changed customers
